content.description: Moneta is building USDM, an essential tool for Cardano. USDM serves as a base asset for decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols and enables instant on-chain payments, accelerating the growth and adoption of the entire Cardano ecosystem. USDM is backed 1:1 by USD bank deposits and money market funds managed by Fidelity and Western Asset Management, ensuring stability and security for all users. Moneta, meaning "coin" or "money" in various languages, is revolutionizing digital finance on the Cardano blockchain.
content.meta: Find out about USDM ($USDM) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
